ticket_shown_to_model.title: Critical UI Alignment Issue in Onboarding Wizard (Staging)
ticket_shown_to_model.description: There is a significant UI element misalignment in the Onboarding Wizard within our staging environment (APAC). The alignment issue is causing critical disruption to the user flow for a large number of users (approx. 12,061). Specifically, the primary action buttons are shifted out of view, preventing completion of the onboarding process. This needs urgent attention as it blocks our release testing.

parsed.summary: The ticket describes a UI alignment issue in the Onboarding Wizard, causing disruption to the user flow. The issue is specific to the staging environment in the APAC region and affects a large number of users.
